title: The persona
src: Jung, Two Essays on Analytical Psychology
idea: The persona is the mask you wear for the roles you play. It is useful, but trouble starts when you forget it is a mask.
apply: Notice one role you play at work or with family, and ask what part of you it leaves out.
remind: Wear the mask. Do not forget your face.
who: Dev, a manager who is upbeat at work and drained at home.

scenes.nar: At work, Dev is always upbeat and never shows doubt. At home, he is silent and drained.
Jung called the face we show the world a persona. It is useful, but Dev's has no room for doubt, tiredness, or asking for help.

items.x: Share one doubt with a trusted colleague
Tell his partner what drained him

scenes.nar: He does not drop the role. He shares one doubt with a trusted colleague, and tells his partner what drained him that day.
A colleague offers real help, home feels less silent, and his work role stays solid. The mask is a tool again.
